title: Feelings
description: Say how you feel and respond when someone else does.

questions.sentence: Tume khusi achha?
options: Han, mu bahut khusi.
Nahin, mu ghara jauchi.
Mu tumaku jane nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Han, mu bahut khusi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am very happy.

questions.sentence: Mu aji khusi achi.
options: I am happy today.
I am sad today.
I am tired today.
questions.correctAnswer: I am happy today.

questions.sentence: Mote aji dukha laguchi.
options: Kahinki, kana heichi?
Han, mu khusi achi.
Mu ghara re achi ebe.
questions.correctAnswer: Kahinki, kana heichi?
questions.translatedSentence: Why, what happened?

questions.sentence: Mote dukha laguchi.
options: I feel sad.
I feel happy.
I feel scared.
questions.correctAnswer: I feel sad.

questions.sentence: Apana khusi achanti?
options: Han, mu bahut khusi achi.
Nahin, mu pakhala khae nahin.
Mu ebe Puri jauchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Han, mu bahut khusi achi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am very happy.

questions.sentence: Mora mana bhala nahin.
options: I am not in a good mood.
My house is not good.
I am not going home.
questions.correctAnswer: I am not in a good mood.

questions.sentence: Aji mo mana bahut bhala.
options: Suni khusi heli.
Mote raga laguchi.
Mu kichhi jane nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Suni khusi heli.
questions.translatedSentence: I am happy to hear that.

questions.sentence: Se bahut khusi achi.
options: He is very happy.
He is very sad.
He is very tired.
questions.correctAnswer: He is very happy.

questions.sentence: Tume kahinki hasuchha?
options: Karana mu bahut khusi.
Karana mote bhoka laguchi.
Karana mu ghara jauchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Karana mu bahut khusi.
questions.translatedSentence: Because I am very happy.

questions.sentence: Tume thaki gala ki?
options: Han, mu bahut thaki gali.
Nahin, mote raga laguchi.
Han, mu bahut khusi achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Han, mu bahut thaki gali.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am very tired.

questions.sentence: Mu aji bahut thaki gali.
options: I am very tired today.
I am very happy today.
I got very angry today.
questions.correctAnswer: I am very tired today.

questions.sentence: Tumaku kahinki raga laguchi?
options: Karana bus bahut deri karila.
Karana mora mana bhala achi.
Karana mote bhoka lagu nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Karana bus bahut deri karila.
questions.translatedSentence: Because the bus was very late.

questions.sentence: Mote tike raga laguchi.
options: I am a little angry.
I am a little tired.
I am a little scared.
questions.correctAnswer: I am a little angry.

questions.sentence: Andhara re mote bhaya laguchi.
options: Chinta kara nahin, mu achi.
Han, mu bahut khusi achi.
Tebe tume ghara ku jaa.
questions.correctAnswer: Chinta kara nahin, mu achi.
questions.translatedSentence: Do not worry, I am here.

questions.sentence: Mote ratire bhaya lage.
options: I feel scared at night.
I feel happy at night.
I sleep well at night.
questions.correctAnswer: I feel scared at night.

questions.sentence: Ghara re basi mote bore laguchi.
options: Chala, bahara ku jiba.
Mu ta bahut khusi achi.
Tume kahinki thaki gala?
questions.correctAnswer: Chala, bahara ku jiba.
questions.translatedSentence: Come on, let us go out.

questions.sentence: Kichhi kama nahin, mote bore laguchi.
options: There is nothing to do, I am bored.
There is a lot of work, I am tired.
There is nothing to eat, I am hungry.
questions.correctAnswer: There is nothing to do, I am bored.

questions.sentence: Tume kahinki chupa achha?
options: Mora mana kichhi lagu nahin.
Mora ghara Cuttack re.
Mote pakhala bhala lage.
questions.correctAnswer: Mora mana kichhi lagu nahin.
questions.translatedSentence: I do not feel like doing anything.

questions.sentence: Tumaku kichhi heichi ki?
options: Nahin, mu thik achi.
Nahin, mu ghara jauchi.
Han, mu tumaku jane.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, mu thik achi.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I am fine.

questions.sentence: Tumara mana kemiti achi aji?
options: How are you feeling today?
How is your family today?
Where are you going today?
questions.correctAnswer: How are you feeling today?

questions.sentence: Apana kichhi chintita achanti ki?
options: Han, tike chinta laguchi.
Han, mu pakhala khaili.
Nahin, mu kali Cuttack jibi.
questions.correctAnswer: Han, tike chinta laguchi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am a little worried.

questions.sentence: Kana heichi, mote kuha.
options: Tell me what happened.
Tell me where you went.
Tell me what you ate.
questions.correctAnswer: Tell me what happened.

questions.sentence: Mo mana aji bhala nahin.
options: Kana heichi, kuha to.
Bhala, mu ebe jauchi.
Han, mote bhoka laguchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Kana heichi, kuha to.
questions.translatedSentence: What happened, do tell me.

questions.sentence: Se kahinki dukhi achi?
options: Why is he sad?
Why is he happy?
Why is he here?
questions.correctAnswer: Why is he sad?

questions.sentence: Apana kemiti anubhaba karuchanti?
options: Mu ebe tike bhala anubhaba karuchi.
Mu Bhubaneswar re rahe.
Mote sakalare chaha bhala lage.
questions.correctAnswer: Mu ebe tike bhala anubhaba karuchi.
questions.translatedSentence: I am feeling a little better now.

questions.sentence: Mote lage tume khusi nuhan.
options: I think you are not happy.
I know that you are very happy.
I hope that you are happy.
questions.correctAnswer: I think you are not happy.

questions.sentence: Tume thik achha to, mukha bhala dishu nahin?
options: Tike matha byatha karuchi.
Han, mu Puri jauchi kali.
Mote ebe tike pani darkar.
questions.correctAnswer: Tike matha byatha karuchi.
questions.translatedSentence: I have a slight headache.

questions.sentence: Mu parikhya re pass heli nahin.
options: Chinta kara nahin, ara thare cheshta kara.
Bahut bhala katha, abhinandan tumaku.
Tebe tume aji bahut khusi achha.
questions.correctAnswer: Chinta kara nahin, ara thare cheshta kara.
questions.translatedSentence: Do not worry, try one more time.

questions.sentence: Sabu thik heijiba, chinta karantu nahin.
options: Everything will be fine, please do not worry.
Everything is finished, please do not come.
Everything is ready, please do not wait.
questions.correctAnswer: Everything will be fine, please do not worry.

questions.sentence: Mote bahut bhaya laguchi, mu kari paribi nahin.
options: Tume niscaya paribha, mu tumara sangare achi.
Tebe tume ghara ku phanti jaa.
Mote bi se kama kariba bhala lage nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Tume niscaya paribha, mu tumara sangare achi.
questions.translatedSentence: You can certainly do it, I am with you.

questions.sentence: Kandantu nahin, mu apananka pakhare achi.
options: Please do not cry, I am right here with you.
Please do not go, I am waiting for you.
Please do not worry, I will call you later.
questions.correctAnswer: Please do not cry, I am right here with you.

questions.sentence: Mo bapa aji asustha, mote bahut bhaya laguchi.
options: Bharasa rakha, sabu thik heijiba.
Tebe tume aji khusi achha bujhili.
Mu tumara bapanku jane nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Bharasa rakha, sabu thik heijiba.
questions.translatedSentence: Keep faith, everything will be fine.

questions.sentence: Tume eka nuhan, ame sabu tumara sangare achu.
options: You are not alone, we are all with you.
You are not late, we are all waiting for you.
You are not wrong, we all agree with you.
questions.correctAnswer: You are not alone, we are all with you.

questions.sentence: Mu aji bahut thaki gali, kichhi bhala lagu nahin.
options: Tike bishrama nia, kali bhala lagiba.
Tebe chala, ame ebe bahara ku jiba.
Mote bi tumara katha bhala lagila nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Tike bishrama nia, kali bhala lagiba.
questions.translatedSentence: Take some rest, you will feel better tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Dhairya dhara, samaya sabu thik kari deba.
options: Be patient, time will set everything right.
Be careful, the road is not good at all.
Be quick, the bus will leave right now.
questions.correctAnswer: Be patient, time will set everything right.

questions.sentence: Dhanyabad, tumara katha suni mote bhala lagila.
options: Kichhi katha nahin, mu sabubele achi.
Nahin, mote ebe bore laguchi.
Han, mu kali Cuttack jauchi.
questions.correctAnswer: Kichhi katha nahin, mu sabubele achi.
questions.translatedSentence: It is nothing, I am always here for you.

questions.sentence: Tumaku pakhala bhala lage ki?
options: Han, mote pakhala bahut bhala lage.
Nahin, mu ebe ghara re nahin.
Mu pakhala kouthi milibe jane nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Han, mote pakhala bahut bhala lage.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I like pakhala very much.

questions.sentence: Mote dalma bhala lage, kintu chhena poda aau besi bhala lage.
options: I like dalma, but I like chhena poda even more.
I like dalma, but I do not like chhena poda.
I do not like dalma, but chhena poda is fine.
questions.correctAnswer: I like dalma, but I like chhena poda even more.

questions.sentence: Tumaku kouthi ghuribaku bhala lage?
options: Mote Puri samudra kula bhala lage.
Mote ratire tike bhaya lage.
Mu sabubele ghara re basi rahe.
questions.correctAnswer: Mote Puri samudra kula bhala lage.
questions.translatedSentence: I like the seaside at Puri.

questions.sentence: Mote sakalare chaha pibaku bhala lage.
options: I like drinking tea in the morning.
I like sleeping late in the morning.
I do not drink tea in the morning.
questions.correctAnswer: I like drinking tea in the morning.

questions.sentence: Tumaku auto re jibaku bhala lage ki?
options: Nahin, mote bus re jibaku besi bhala lage.
Han, mote auto re jibaku bhala lage nahin.
Mu auto re basi bahut thaki gali.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, mote bus re jibaku besi bhala lage.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I prefer to travel by bus.

questions.sentence: Mu kebe kebe Jagannath mandira jibaku chahen.
options: Sometimes I want to go to the Jagannath temple.
I go to the Jagannath temple every single day.
I have never gone to the Jagannath temple.
questions.correctAnswer: Sometimes I want to go to the Jagannath temple.

questions.sentence: Tume chhutire kana karibaku chahun?
options: Mu Puri jai samudra dekhibaku chahen.
Mu kali bahut thaki gali thili.
Mote se sinema bhala lagila nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Mu Puri jai samudra dekhibaku chahen.
questions.translatedSentence: I want to go to Puri and see the sea.

questions.sentence: Mote thanda pani pibaku bhala lage nahin.
options: I do not like drinking cold water.
I really like drinking cold water.
I do not like this cold weather.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not like drinking cold water.

questions.sentence: Tumara iccha kana, ame aji kana khaiba?
options: Chala, ame kichhi Odia khadya khaiba.
Mote ebe kichhi bhoka lagu nahin.
Mu ranna kariba kebe jane nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Chala, ame kichhi Odia khadya khaiba.
questions.translatedSentence: Let us go and eat some Odia food.

questions.sentence: Mote lage Bhubaneswar Cuttack tharu bhala sahara.
options: Mu puri raji nuhen, duita nija dhanga re sundara.
Han, mu Cuttack kebe jai nahin.
Mote sahara re rahiba bhala lage nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Mu puri raji nuhen, duita nija dhanga re sundara.
questions.translatedSentence: I do not fully agree, both are beautiful in their own way.

questions.sentence: Mu deri re asili boli mote kshama karantu.
options: Please forgive me for arriving late.
Please tell me why you arrived late.
I will forgive you if you arrive late.
questions.correctAnswer: Please forgive me for arriving late.

questions.sentence: Mu kali apananku phone kari parili nahin, kshama karantu.
options: Kichhi asubidha nahin, mu bujhi paruchi.
Han, mu apananku kali phone karithili.
Tebe apana kali kahinki khusi thile?
questions.correctAnswer: Kichhi asubidha nahin, mu bujhi paruchi.
questions.translatedSentence: No problem at all, I understand.

questions.sentence: Jadi tumara mana bhala nahin, tebe ame kali jiba.
options: If you are not feeling well, then we will go tomorrow.
If you are feeling well, then we will go today itself.
Since you were not well, we did not go yesterday.
questions.correctAnswer: If you are not feeling well, then we will go tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Mo katha re tumaku dukha lagila, sethi pain mu dukhita.
options: Thik achi, mu se katha bhuli gali.
Han, mote tumara katha bahut bhala lagila.
Tebe tume aau mo sangare katha kara nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Thik achi, mu se katha bhuli gali.
questions.translatedSentence: It is alright, I have already forgotten about it.

questions.sentence: Mu raga re se katha kahili, kintu mora se uddesya nathila.
options: I said that in anger, but I did not mean it.
I said that with love, but he did not listen to me.
I did not say that, but he still got angry with me.
questions.correctAnswer: I said that in anger, but I did not mean it.

questions.sentence: Apana kana bhabanti, e katha thik ki nuhen?
options: Mote lage e thik nuhen, karana kahaku puchara heli nahin.
Han, mote pakhala dalma bahut bhala lage.
Mu apananka ghara kouthi achi jane nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Mote lage e thik nuhen, karana kahaku puchara heli nahin.
questions.translatedSentence: I think it is not right, because nobody was asked.

questions.sentence: Mu apananka katha re sahamata, kintu mote tike samaya darkar.
options: I agree with you, but I need a little time.
I agree with you, and I am ready right now.
I do not agree with you, and I have no time.
questions.correctAnswer: I agree with you, but I need a little time.

questions.sentence: Tume mo upare raga achha ki, satya kuha.
options: Nahin, mote raga nahin, khali tike dukha lagila.
Han, mu tumaku bhala bhabare jane nahin.
Mote ebe ghara ku jibaku padiba nahin.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, mote raga nahin, khali tike dukha lagila.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I am not angry, I just felt a little hurt.
